title: 自立フレーム付きサンドバッグ
description: トレーニング室のボクシング区画へ置く、自立スタンドと吊り下げ式サンドバッグの一式。丸めた袋本体と縫い目、四方向の金属チェーン、上部アイ金具、張り出しアームと補強材、連結した接地レール、重り風の積層プレートを造形。袋と重りはこの1点の部品です。揺動・打撃判定・調整はなく、運動器具としての荷重・安定性・安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.580 × 2.602 × 1.440 m、32,088三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A freestanding heavy-bag assembly for a boxing area in a training room. It has a rounded upholstered bag with seams, four linked suspension chains, upper eye fittings, cantilever arm/braces, connected floor rails and stacked ballast-looking plates. The bag and plates belong to one counted assembly. Swinging, hit detection and adjustment are absent; load capacity, stability and exercise-equipment safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.580 × 2.602 × 1.440 m; 32,088 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
